source_count_review.closers_rule: Nim dedentation creates no written closer unit. Literal, tuple, type-parameter and argument punctuation is structural; type declaration headers and fields are independently owned. The compare scalar-composition exemption is retained exactly, not broadened to code() whose raising else is imperative.
source_count_review.normalization_arithmetic: 64 physical +2 Entry fields +3 Job fields +1 inline pragma +1 thread pragma +5 code case-arm bodies -4 compare expression continuation lines =72.

required_work.lookup_api: mgetOrPut(key, 0_i64) returns var int64 for the actual hash slot; .inc mutates it for every overlapping window. Growth may perform additional re-probing; no exactly-one-probe claim is made.
required_work.growth: Generic stdlib open addressing with hash+key comparisons, linear nextTry, mustRehash load/spare-slot checks, factor2 enlarge; only absent insertion triggers growth.
required_work.preencoding: thirdRecord().mapIt(uint8(code(it))) maps each DNA letter once to0..3. Each of seven workers still scans the entire encoded sequence and rolls a36-bit-or-smaller key, then looks up and updates every complete window.
required_work.small_inputs: Empty/short input still starts each default table; no window means no update. A singleton width1 window performs a real table insertion and count increment.
required_work.query_extraction: Full maps are built at widths3/4/6/12/18 before five final query lookups. k1/k2 tables are fully iterated, totaled and sorted with descending count/ascending text.

thread_and_representation_review.input_owner: Main owns immutable seq[uint8] until all worker joins; Job passes pointer to same sequence.
thread_and_representation_review.output_owners: Distinct parent-owned counts[index] Table per thread, same joined lifetime arrangement as retained parent.
thread_and_representation_review.integer_keys: Mask (1_u64 shl(2*width))-1 supports longest36-bit key; uint8 codes convert back to uint64 before shifts/OR.
thread_and_representation_review.counts: int64 counters safely hold canonical sequence length.
thread_and_representation_review.behavior_change: Invalid DNA is rejected during main-thread preencoding rather than later in worker scans; generated ACGT and all required valid records retain semantics. No stronger malformed-input behavior claim.

source_count_review.admission: application_loc remains null until independent root review accepts exact new source and retained policy extension.
